reason: The Greater Bengaluru dataset records POSSESSION timing, not sale dates. Every price was observed at a single point in time, so no price series over time exists and no market forecast can be produced from this data.
why_this_matters: A trend across possession years would measure the discount on unfinished property, not market appreciation. Presenting it as a price forecast would be wrong.
what_would_be_needed: Sale or listing dates on each record (as the Chennai dataset has), or
A published locality-level price index over several years, or
Repeated scrapes of the same listings over time

supported_analysis.name: Possession-timing premium
supported_analysis.method: Median price per sq.ft by possession year, plus a linear fit
supported_analysis.interpretation: Ready-to-move properties are listed at a premium over under-construction ones. This is a possession-timing effect, NOT a market trend over time.
